incident-bot: PAGE: [PD-3749] ded-pool node gpu-42 (ded-summit-1) reporting ECC parity spikes -> kernel panic risk. Auto-evict triggered. Affected: SummitCorp dedicated pool. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-3749
ops-oncall: ack — I'm taking this. paging infra/hw and eng leads.
ops-oncall: handing lead to @sara-ng for hardware + node actions.
sara-ng: oncall here. confirming metrics: ECC errors increasing on gpu-42, nvidia-smi shows ECC_COUNT: 124 -> 210 over 6m. Preparing drain + tenant evacuation. tagging @solutions-eng for customer comms.
tom-w: copying in comms. quick question — how many active SummitCorp sessions on that pool?
ops-oncall: current snapshot: ded-summit-1 has 18 active sessions; summitcorp tenant-s-17 has 3 active inference sessions (2 high-tdp), rest are lower priority.
sara-ng: plan: cordon+drain node, migrate tenant sessions to spare capacity, keep preemptible spare ready in case of spot interruption, and schedule RMA if hardware fault confirmed. Running commands now:
```
# cordon + drain
kubectl cordon node/gpu-42
kubectl drain node/gpu-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
# our helper for ded pools
redwoodctl dedpool evacuate --pool ded-summit-1 --node gpu-42 --target spare-1 --force
```
rajiv: started evacuation script (evacuate-job-8842). Logs: "migrated 2/3 pods for tenant-s-17, 1 pod pending image pull on spare-1". Prefetch cache flush kicked.
ops-oncall: observed transient tail-latency increase for SummitCorp: p95 went 65ms -> 185ms during migration. Customers may notice short latency blips.
tom-w: drafting customer note: "We're actively draining a failed GPU node in your dedicated pool. We've migrated your active jobs to a spare node; you may see brief latency increases. No data loss expected. We'll follow up with ETA for replacement." Want to send now? @kevin-m to confirm tone.
kevin-m: send now with that wording. customer is on standby; have them on a quick call if needed.
sara-ng: migration complete for tenant-s-17. Verifying health: run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used,ecc.errors --format=csv` on spare-1 -> OK.
ops-oncall: confirm: all SummitCorp workloads are now running on spare-1. 0 pods pending. Latency back to baseline ~70ms.
ops-oncall: scheduling RMA with datacenter: ticket DC-9987, ETA parts arrival 02:00 UTC. If spare remains stable we'll keep traffic routed and replace node during low-traffic window.
sara-ng: root cause likely thermal-induced ECC escalation (fan telemetry shows sustained 95%C for 10m before spike). We'll include thermal sensors and nv-firmware versions in postmortem.
ops-oncall: Incident status: Mitigation complete; node drained + tenant isolation performed; customers migrated. Marking incident RESOLVED -> MONITORING for 30m. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: PD-3749 status changed to RESOLVED (mitigation complete).
tom-w: postmortem owner: @sara-ng. Action items: 1) confirm RMA replacement + firmware, 2) add preemptive eviction policy for ECC rate >50/min, 3) update customer runbook for dedicated pool events.
sara-ng: will own and create postmortem draft. ETA EOD.
ops-oncall: thanks team — leave monitor on for 30m, will close PD after monitoring window. :thumbsup:
